message.name: SEES_GPS_INPUT
message.description: Sees variant of GPS_INPUT, adding course/heading accuracy and UTC time. All fields up to and including yaw have identical semantics to GPS_INPUT. This is a raw sensor value sent by the GPS. This is NOT the global position estimate of the system.
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX Epoch time or time since system boot). The receiving end can infer timestamp format (since 1.1.1970 or since system boot) by checking for the magnitude of the number.
ID of the GPS for multiple GPS inputs
Bitmap indicating which GPS input flags fields to ignore. All other fields must be provided.
GPS time (from start of GPS week)
GPS week number
0-1: no fix, 2: 2D fix, 3: 3D fix. 4: 3D with DGPS. 5: 3D with RTK
Latitude (WGS84)
Longitude (WGS84)
Altitude (MSL). Positive for up.
GPS HDOP horizontal dilution of position (unitless). If unknown, set to: UINT16_MAX
GPS VDOP vertical dilution of position (unitless). If unknown, set to: UINT16_MAX
GPS velocity in north direction in earth-fixed NED frame
GPS velocity in east direction in earth-fixed NED frame
GPS velocity in down direction in earth-fixed NED frame
GPS speed accuracy
GPS horizontal accuracy
GPS vertical accuracy
Number of satellites visible.
Yaw of vehicle relative to Earth's North, zero means not available, use 36000 for north
GPS course over ground accuracy (1-sigma). If unknown, set to: NaN
GPS heading accuracy (1-sigma). If unknown, set to: NaN
GPS UTC time (UNIX Epoch). If unknown, set to: 0
